stories.title: EN DIRECT - Visite du pape en France : Léon XIV rassemble des dizaines de milliers de fidèles à Lourdes

en.title: LIVE - Pope's visit to France: Leo XIV draws tens of thousands of faithful to Lourdes
en.summary: Following Paris, Pope Leo XIV continues his French visit in Lourdes with a mass and a meeting with victims of sexual abuse in the Church.

stories.title: Cinq personnes arrêtées en Angleterre après un "incident majeur" près d'une base militaire utilisée par l'armée américaine, la police antiterroriste saisie

en.title: Five people arrested in England after "major incident" near military base used by US military, counterterrorism police involved
en.summary: Five individuals were arrested in England near a US military base, suspected of breaching explosives laws. Counterterrorism police have taken over the investigation.

stories.title: Au Royaume-Uni, des arrestations après un «incident majeur» près d’une base utilisée par l’US Air Force

en.title: In the United Kingdom, arrests after a "major incident" near a base used by the US Air Force
en.summary: Five people were arrested Sunday near Fairford Air Base for alleged violations of explosives laws. Counterterrorism police are conducting the investigation.

stories.title: Visite du pape en France : "Ce qui est légal n'est pas nécessairement moral", juge Léon XIV, dans un discours sur la fin de vie prononcé à Lourdes

en.title: Pope's visit to France: "What is legal is not necessarily moral," Leo XIV says in speech on end-of-life delivered in Lourdes
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV delivers a speech in Lourdes on end-of-life issues, stating that rejecting the temptation to give death is a fundamental principle during a meeting with the sick.

stories.title: Visite du pape à Lourdes : Léon XIV réaffirme son opposition à l’aide à mourir et dénonce le « fléau » des violences sexuelles au sein de l’Eglise

en.title: Pope Leo XIV's visit to Lourdes: Leo XIV reaffirms opposition to assisted dying and denounces 'scourge' of sexual violence within the Church
en.summary: During his third day visiting France, the Pope strongly reiterated his opposition to assisted dying and urged French bishops to continue combating child abuse within the Church.

stories.title: Un « incident majeur » près d’une base utilisée par l’aviation américaine au Royaume-Uni, cinq arrestations

en.title: A 'major incident' near a base used by American aviation in the United Kingdom, five arrests
en.summary: Bomb disposal experts inspected multiple vehicles near a Royal Air Force base in Fairford, and nearby homes were evacuated following a major incident investigation.

stories.title: A Lourdes, le Pape Léon XIV attendu sur les abus sexuels de l'Eglise

en.title: In Lourdes, Pope Leo XIV expected to address Church sexual abuse
en.summary: A reporter provides coverage from Lourdes where Pope Leo XIV is addressing the issue of sexual abuse within the Church.

stories.title: Le pape Léon XIV encourage l'Eglise de France à "poursuivre" son action face au "douloureux fléau" des violences sexuelles

en.title: Pope Leo XIV encourages the French Church to 'continue' its action against the 'painful scourge' of sexual violence
en.summary: The Pope addressed French bishops on sexual violence within the Church, five years after a report documented approximately 330,000 minor victims since 1950.

stories.title: Visite du pape en France : bain de foule, pèlerins malades et victimes de violences sexuelles au programme de Léon XIV

en.title: Pope's visit to France: crowds, sick pilgrims and sexual abuse victims on Leo XIV's schedule
en.summary: The Pope continues his French visit with a Sunday in Lourdes, where he will meet seven victims of sexual abuse within the Church, an encounter expected to draw significant scrutiny.

stories.title: Le Pape Léon XIV attendu à Metz, après sa visite à Paris et Lourdes

en.title: Pope Leo XIV expected in Metz after visits to Paris and Lourdes
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV will travel to Metz on Monday morning for the final stage of his visit to France, which will have a more European and interreligious focus.

stories.title: Visite du pape en France : avez-vous été touché par les messages de Léon XIV à Paris et Lourdes ?

en.title: Pope's visit to France: were you moved by León XIV's messages in Paris and Lourdes?
en.summary: The Pope delivered messages during his visits to Paris and Lourdes in France, prompting reflection on their impact among the public.

stories.title: Léon XIV en France : après Paris, le pape est arrivé à Lourdes

en.title: Leon XIV in France: after Paris, the pope arrives in Lourdes
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV, who arrived in France on Friday, is continuing his four-day visit to the country. Saturday's main event includes an outdoor mass in central Paris.

stories.title: Valdunes : un nouveau prêt de l’État pour la dernière usine de roue ferroviaire

en.title: Valdunes: a new state loan for the last French railway wheel factory
en.summary: The French government has released an additional 1.5 million euros to support Valdunes, the country's sole manufacturer of railway wheels. The company has been operating below capacity since its acquisition by Europlasma two and a half years ago.

stories.title: Cuivre : en route vers les 15 000 dollars la tonne ?

en.title: Copper: heading towards 15,000 dollars per tonne?
en.summary: Copper prices are approaching 15,000 dollars per tonne, a level considered ambitious a year ago. An accident at the world's largest mine, declining Chinese stockpiles, and potential US tariffs are driving the surge.

stories.title: Sénat : quel poids dans les débats économiques ?

en.title: Senate: what weight in economic debates?
en.summary: The renewal of 178 Senate seats on September 27 highlights the chamber's role in economic discussions. While the Senate does not decide alone, it effectively defends local finances and brings issues to public debate.

stories.title: « Ça m’a beaucoup aidé mentalement » : Cyril Baille, le pilier du XV de France régénéré par le golf

en.title: "It helped me a lot mentally": Cyril Baille, France's rugby pillar rejuvenated by golf
en.summary: Toulouse's front row player Cyril Baille, who suffered lengthy injuries, found renewed purpose through golf and achieved a high level of proficiency in the sport. His success on the fairway has coincided with his return to rugby form.

stories.title: C’était ça ou la littérature. La chronique de Guillaume Durand

en.title: It was this or literature. Guillaume Durand's column
en.summary: A monthly column in which the chronicler offers commentary on political matters and current events.
